items.text: Every B1 round delivers VisionD Web ZIP, matching V Easy Source ZIP and a signed installable APK together
items.acceptance: all three named artifacts exist, are nonempty and pass archive or APK structure checks before handoff

items.text: The approved release pair is VisionD v0.14.110 and V Easy source and APK v1.0.9
items.acceptance: web VERSION, mobile package, Android config, runtime and APK metadata agree with the approved versions

items.text: Every approved mobile form and field is copied into the packaged Android assets without missing required controls
items.acceptance: sync output preserves form IDs, input names, required markers, select options and submit actions from public to android-app

items.text: Web activation account key shop session and catalog contracts match the mobile runtime callers
items.acceptance: an authenticated holder may claim an unbound V Easy key on first use; the atomic claim then binds that account and one shop, while another account is denied and directed to Boss re-key support

items.text: The APK remains one generic credential-free build with stable package identity and one-key-one-shop V Easy activation in Settings
items.acceptance: package is com.visiondonline.veasy, contains no customer credentials, is signed, and activation stays inside Settings

items.text: The produced APK must pass automated inspection and a recorded smoke matrix on the approved Android test device
items.acceptance: APK is structurally valid and signed, then install launch Settings activation Back camera and session update are recorded for Redmi Note 14 Pro+ 5G Android 16 HyperOS 3.0.304.0
